audit_items.proof_trace: supplyRate = borrowRate × util_rate × (1 − reserve_factor). util_rate ≤ 1 is enforced by the cash >= cash_reserve invariant checked in withdraw_underlying (L313); reserve_factor = repay_fee_rate is a Decimal (unsigned, ≥ 0). Therefore util_rate × (1 − reserve_factor) ≤ 1, and supplyRate ≤ borrowRate holds structurally. The repay_fee_rate-as-reserve_factor bug (report_057) does not break this ordering — it only reduces the protocol's earned reserves; any value in [0,1] preserves the supply-rate-lower-than-borrow-rate invariant.
